# Job Chapter 33 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 428v–429r

---

**33:1** But hear now, Iyyov [Job], my-speech [milati], and-all my-words [devarai] give-ear [ha'azin]. **33:2** Behold, now I-have-opened my-mouth [pi]; my-tongue speaks [dibberah] in-my-palate [bechikki]. **33:3** The-uprightness [yosher] of-my-heart [libbi] [are] my-words [amarai], and-knowledge [da'at] my-lips speak [milelu] purely [barur].

**33:4** The-Spirit of-God [ruach-El] made-me [asatni], and-the-breath of-the-Almighty [nishmat Shaddai] gives-me-life [techayeni]. **33:5** If you-are-able [tukhal], answer-me [hashiveni]; set-in-order [arkhah] before-me [lefanai], take-your-stand [hityatsav].

**33:6** Behold, I [am] like-your-mouth [kefika] to-God [la-El]; from-clay [me-chomer] I-was-pinched-off [qaratsti] also I. **33:7** Behold, my-dread [eimatai] shall-not terrify-you [lo tevahatek], and-my-pressure [akhpi] upon-you shall-not be-heavy [lo yikhbad].

**33:8** Surely [akh] you-have-said in-my-ears [be-oznai], and-the-sound of-words [qol millin] I-hear [eshma]: **33:9** "Pure [zakh] I [am], without transgression [beli-pasha]; clean [chaf] I [am], and-there-is-no iniquity [avon] in-me. **33:10** Behold, occasions [tenu'ot] against-me he-finds [yimtsa]; he-counts-me [yachsheveni] as-an-enemy [le-oyev] to-him. **33:11** He-puts [yasem] my-feet [raglai] in-the-stocks [ba-sad]; he-watches [yishmor] all my-paths [orchotai]."

**33:12** Behold, in-this you-are-not righteous [lo tsadaqta], I-answer-you [e'eneka], for God [Eloah] is-greater [yirbeh] than-a-man [me-enosh]. **33:13** Why against-him do-you-contend [ravta]? For all his-words [devarav] he-does-not answer [lo ya'aneh].

**33:14** For in-one-way [be-achat] God [El] speaks [yedabber], and-in-two [u-vishtayim] — he-does-not perceive-it [lo yeshurenah]. **33:15** In-a-dream [ba-chalom], a-vision [chezyon] of-the-night [lailah], in-the-falling of-deep-sleep [tardema] upon men [anashim], in-slumberings [bi-tnumot] upon the-bed [mishkav]: **33:16** Then he-opens [yigleh] the-ear [ozen] of-men, and-in-their-instruction [u-ve-mosaram] he-seals [yachtom], **33:17** to-turn-aside [le-hasir] a-man from-a-deed [ma'aseh], and-pride [ge'vah] from-a-man [gever] he-hides [yekhasse].

**33:18** He-keeps-back [yachsokh] his-soul [nafsho] from-the-pit [min-shachat], and-his-life [chayato] from-passing [me-avor] through-the-channel [ba-shelach]. **33:19** And-he-is-chastened [ve-hukach] with-pain [be-makh'ov] upon his-bed [mishkavo], and-the-strife of-his-bones [riv atzamav] [is] enduring [eitan]. **33:20** And-his-life [chayato] loathes [zihamathu] bread [lechem], and-his-soul [nafsho] food of-desire [ma'akhal ta'avah].

**33:21** His-flesh [besaro] wastes-away [yikhleh] from-sight [me-roi], and-his-bones [atsmotav] [that] were-not-seen [lo ru'u] are-laid-bare [shuphefu]. **33:22** And-draws-near [va-tiqrav] to-the-pit [la-shachat] his-soul [nafsho], and-his-life [chayato] to-the-death-dealers [la-memitim].

**33:23** If there-is over-him an-angel [malakh], a-mediator [melits], one of-a-thousand [echad min-alef], to-declare to-a-man his-uprightness [yoshro]: **33:24** And-he-is-gracious [vayechunenu] to-him and-says, "Redeem-him [peda'ehu] from-going-down [me-redet] to-the-pit [shachat]; I-have-found [matsati] a-ransom [kofer]."

**33:25** His-flesh [besaro] is-renewed [rutafash] more-than-a-child's [mi-no'ar]; he-returns [yashuv] to-the-days of-his-youth [alumav]. **33:26** He-prays [ye'etar] to God [Eloah] and-he-accepts-him [vayirtshehu], and-he-sees [vayar] his-face [panav] with-a-shout-of-joy [bi-teru'ah], and-he-restores [vayashev] to-a-man [le-enosh] his-righteousness [tsidqato].

**33:27** He-looks [yashur] upon men [anashim] and-says, "I-sinned [chatati] and-the-upright [yashar] I-perverted [he'eveti], and-it-was-not equal [lo shavah] to-me." **33:28** He-redeemed [padah] my-soul [nafshi] from-passing [me-avor] into-the-pit [ba-shachat], and-my-life [chayati] in-the-light [ba-or] shall-see [tir'eh].

**33:29** Behold, all these [things] God [El] works [yif'al], twice [pa'amayim], three-times [shalosh] with-a-man [im-gaver], **33:30** to-bring-back [le-hashiv] his-soul [nafsho] from-the-pit [min-shachat], to-be-enlightened [le-or] with-the-light of-the-living [be-or ha-chayyim].

**33:31** Pay-attention [haqshev], Iyyov, hear-me [shema-li]; be-silent [hacharesh], and-I will-speak [adabber]. **33:32** If there-are words [millin], answer-me [hashiveni]; speak [dabber], for I-desire [chafatsti] to-justify-you [tsaddaqeka]. **33:33** If not [im ayin], you hear-me [shema-li]; be-silent [hacharesh], and-I-will-teach-you [va-alefkha] wisdom [chokhmah].

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.6 — "like your mouth to God":** The Hebrew *kefika la-El* is obscure. Many read this as "according to your wish/desire before God" — i.e., Elihu is the human advocate Job requested, not an overwhelming divine presence.

**v.23 — "a mediator, one of a thousand":** Hebrew *melits*, a key term — an interpreter or advocate angel. This anticipates the heavenly mediator Job longed for (9:33, 16:19). The "one of a thousand" suggests the rarity and preciousness of such intervention.

**v.24 — "I have found a ransom":** Hebrew *kofer* — a ransom price or covering. This verse is theologically significant: divine grace provides what human merit cannot. The speaker may be the angel or God himself.

*— EMET*
